description:
FOUND s470bz (Opus, 2026-09-07) while doing #1302 (b).  PCLPaths::root/root_of
is now the one derivation for the eight callers task #1302 lists (pcl, pl2cl,
runpcl, tools/sweep-perl-tests.pl, tools/pclperl-for-tests, tools/runt,
tools/clt, PCLSbcl::_installed_core).  Pl/ProtoCache.pm has three more, all
spelled `dirname($PL_DIR)` where $PL_DIR is Cwd::abs_path(dirname(__FILE__)):

  * :137  $toolslib = dirname($PL_DIR) . '/tools/lib'   -- THE BOOTSTRAP.  This
          one must stay: it is how the file finds PCLPaths at all.
  * :152  $rt = dirname($PL_DIR) . '/cl/pcl-runtime.lisp'  -- the generation
          string's source.
  * :464  push @d, dirname($PL_DIR) . '/lib'   -- PCL's own shim directory, in
          the trust classifier that decides which modules get a fasl.

The last two are later derivations and could go through
PCLPaths::root_of(__FILE__), which would also VERIFY the answer
(cl/pcl-runtime.lisp being there) instead of assuming it.  Neither is wrong
today: ProtoCache lives at <root>/Pl/, so one level up is the root in a
checkout and in an installed tree alike.

WHY IT WAS LEFT: line 464 feeds the compile-dirs default and therefore the
manifest's `source` line, so changing it owes an emission A/B plus the
module-fasl-cache rows; that is a separate change from the one s470bz was
measuring, and the s470bz brief enumerates its callers.  Do it with the next
piece of work that already touches ProtoCache.

BAR when it is done: corpus-diff IDENTICAL, Pl/t/module-fasl-cache-01.t and
Pl/t/manifest-01.t green, and a row in Pl/t/pcl-root-01.t asserting the
bootstrap and root_of agree for ProtoCache the way they do for the other eight.
